factErrors: beat 'altitude-a' (and its EN alt) hint 3: 'Chân đường cao là điểm của đường BC gần A nhất' is false in general — the nearest point of the line BC to A is the foot only when the foot lies on the segment BC; in the obtuse preset the foot Ha=(0.35,1.41) lies outside segment BC, so the nearest point of the segment is B, not Ha.

beat 'altitude-a' misconception (and its EN alt): 'với tam giác tù nó nằm trên phần kéo dài của BC' is false for the altitude from A — in the obtuse preset Ha lies on segment BC; the feet on the extensions are those of the altitudes from B and C (Hb=(3,-3) on line CA, Hc=(-2,0) on line AB).

beat 'orthocenter' hint 3 (and its EN alt): 'Tam giác tù: H nằm ngoài, ở phần kéo dài của các đường cao' is wrong — the orthocenter lies on the altitudes themselves, not on their extensions beyond the feet; in the obtuse preset H=(-2,-8) lies on the altitude lines but on no extension of the altitude segments.

beat 'predict-meet' hint 3 (and its EN alt): 'ta sẽ thấy lý do qua hình' claims the figure shows why the three altitudes are concurrent, but the figure only exhibits one numeric case; the general theorem is not proved by the picture.

frame 6 of every preset (and the 'done' narration): 'Ba đường cao luôn đồng quy' is asserted as a general theorem after only four special numeric triangles, with no proof or justification — a general claim supported only by special cases.

issues.problem: The dot-product hint ('tích vô hướng của AHa với BC bằng 0') uses a concept beyond the stated grade-8-12 prerequisite level and is not explained.
issues.fix: Replace with a level-appropriate justification (e.g. the foot is the point where the perpendicular from the vertex meets the opposite line) or define the dot product first.

issues.problem: The hint 'Chân đường cao là điểm của đường BC gần A nhất' is ambiguous between the segment BC and the line BC, which is exactly the distinction the lesson needs.
issues.fix: Say explicitly 'điểm của đường thẳng BC gần A nhất' and note that this point may lie outside the segment.

issues.problem: The orthocenter is introduced and the concurrency theorem stated without any argument; the walkthrough never says the picture is only intuition for the general fact.
issues.fix: Add one sentence stating that the figure illustrates the theorem for these triangles and that the general proof comes later, or give a short angle-chasing argument.

issues.problem: The summary line 'Trực tâm nằm trong tam giác nhọn, tại đỉnh góc vuông của tam giác vuông, và ngoài tam giác tù' is stated without the condition that the triangle is non-degenerate (three non-collinear vertices), which the pseudo-code does state.
